purpose: Confidentiality relationship: details below follow your notes. This agreement protects confidential information shared in connection with reviewing and sharing a pitch deck. The receiving party may use the pitch deck and related information only to evaluate the proposed opportunity and for no other purpose unless the disclosing party gives written permission. The receiving party must keep the information confidential, limit access to people who need to see it for that evaluation, and use reasonable care to prevent unauthorized disclosure. If the pitch deck includes business plans, financials, product details, customer information, or other sensitive materials, those materials are covered by the same confidentiality obligations. Any ownership of the underlying pitch deck and related materials stays with the disclosing party unless the parties later agree otherwise in writing. The agreement begins when fully executed by the parties and continues until the confidential information no longer needs protection under the agreement or the parties end it under its terms.
title: Confidentiality Agreement
